bio.text: Ray Pooley is the Democratic candidate for Michigan's 9th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 4 primary.
Ballotpedia lists a high school diploma from Hartland High School and career experience as a machinist.

In his responses to Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, Pooley describes himself as a third-generation manufacturer and CNC machinist and programmer with 15 years of personal experience in the industry.
